title: Opening descriptor
description: The fixed description of a Session's opening range (W, H] (009_sync.md, continuity.md). H is pinned at Session birth and never re-sampled at REFILL dispatch; W is the restored Save's proven frontier, or 0 for a cross-seed opening. The handoff digest appears once the Handoff has been rendered, and is what a custody driver looks for as evidence of delivery — the digest, not the text, because equal content is not equal delivery.

saveId.description: The Save this opening restored from, or null for a cross-seed opening where W is 0.

commandId.description: The one Handoff command reserved for this range; null while none has been reserved.
